description: Submit usability feedback about an aos command or function through aos-feedback. Feedback is collected for later improvement; it does not change the target. The default author is aos-agent; supply by explicitly to identify a different author.

command.description: Command or function being reviewed, preserved literally, for example aos-agent ctl add or lib/base/read.

score.description: Optional comfort score from 0 to 1; 1 means comfortable.

by.description: Feedback author; the tool does not infer who called it.
